name: FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer
description:
Bring FaithGPT into Claude for Scripture-rooted Christian support. Look up exact Bible passages in KJV, ASV, or YLT; find Bible verses by topic; ask questions about Christianity, theology, prayer, spiritual growth, and daily faith; review sermons and doctrine for theological and Scripture-use concerns; and create personal devotionals with a passage, reflection, and prayer.

FaithGPT is built for Christians, Bible study groups, pastors, ministry leaders, theology students, and people exploring the Christian faith. Its tools do not publish or change external data; they return Bible text and guidance inside Claude. FaithGPT is not a replacement for pastoral, medical, legal, or emergency care.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.faithgpt.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer provides these MCP tools: ask_faithgpt, create_devotional, find_scripture_by_topic, lookup_scripture, and review_doctrine.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: FaithGPT: Christian Bible Study & Prayer is developed by FaithGPT. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
